catalyst.name: Whisper Catalyst, Whispered Breathing
catalyst.description:
Grants 30 Reload Speed.
Aiming Down Sights for 1.2 seconds without shooting grants 'Whispered Breathing' until you leave ADS.
Whispered Breathing grants 35% increased precision damage, and an additional 10.77% increased damage against combatants.
Grants 30 Reload Speed.
